Teekhi buddhi atyachari ko chamatkar mein daal deti hai.
Ek prasann baat sabse andhere hisse ko roshan karti hai.
Dil ek aisa kila hai jise todna mushkil hai.
Hansi dukh ki kshanik mrityu hai.
Rooh kismat ke tarashe raaston par chalti hai.
Ek chatur chaal smarak se zyada chalti hai.
Ek prasann hriday cheekhte toofaan ka mazak udata hai.
Bina pariksha ka man jangli pashu hai.
Lalach ek atal pyaala hai.
Langar sirf gahre paani mein tike.
Man apani pinjara banata hai, phir rota hai.
Yatra ek akele kadam se shuru ho.
Bhoolna insaan ka swabhaav hai; bhool mein rehna moorhta hai.
Shabd beej hain; dhyan se bo-o.
Tark sabhyata ke dimaag ka compass hai.
Gyan bhatakte dimaag ka langar hai.
Rooh chupchaap ladi ladaiyon ke zakhm pehnti hai.
Hansi nirasha ke khilaf sabse achha kavach hai.
Jo ujaale se bhage, chhaya unka peecha kare.
Hosh arajakta ke sath ek nazuk samjhauta hai.
Ek chatur tippani jeebh par dhalas sona hai.
Buddhi tark ke galiyaaron mein roshni hai.
Bhokne wala kutta khargosh nahi pakad pata.
Teekha mazak gyaani ka hathiyar hai.
Jeb munh mein rakhi tez talwar hai.
Buddhi woh aag hai jo vicharak ko garmi deti hai.
Teekhi jubaan do dhaar wali gladius talwar hai.
Haasya ajnabiyon ke beech ki khaayi patata hai.
Atmavishwas me manav disha suchak tezi se ghoomta hai.
Dimaag wahan ghoomta hai jahan sharir zanjeeron mein ho.
Chalak dimaag jhukta hai jahan kathor toot jata hai.
Ek chatur shabd toofaan me prakash stambh hai.
Krodhi man apana munh khole aur aankh band kare.
Ahankari dil vastavikta se takra kar toot ta hai.
Jo khud ko chatur samjhe, wah bandar par doobta hai.
Rooh chup chaap raaton mein apne raaz tolti hai.
Dil ke paas wo wajehein hain jo vichar nahi jaante.
Ahankar se bharne par aatma ki naav chhed ho jaati hai.
Hum taare napte hain, par andar rasta kho dete hain.
Ek prasann swabhaav sabse accha samaan hai.
Hum kshitij khojte hain, vartaman se andhe hokar.
Hum taaron se chalte hain, par andhere me thokar khate hain.
Dimaag ek aisi bhulbhulaiya hai jiska koi guide nahi.
Dil ek aisa dhokebaaz hai jo dimaag ki nahi sunta.
Jo ek hi patthar par do baar thokar khaaaye, vah moorh hai.
Chatur lomdi apni hi poochh se pakdi jaaye.
Ahankaar kohre ka bana darpan hai.
